eligibility_clues: Applicable to full-time UGC-allocated students only
Granted to selected full-time research students based on academic merit
All new eligible students are considered as part of admission to a research degree programme. No separate application is required

opportunities.amount_note: Handbook, February 2026: 'In the 2025/26 academic year, the studentship Basic Rate is HK$19,100 per month and the Advanced Rate is HK$19,600 per month. Studentship is subject to revision in September of every year, and any revision to the rate will apply to both current and new students.' The School of Energy and Environment 2026/27 leaflet prints the same two rates. A post-September 2026 rate was not confirmed because the live scholarships page could not be fetched.
opportunities.deadline_note: No separate studentship deadline is printed. The February 2026 handbook says applications are considered mainly in one admission round, for which the deadline is normally the first week of December 2025. The live 2027/28 steps page could not be fetched. A Department of Biomedical Sciences page prints an application deadline of 11:59 pm, 1 December 2026, and a provisional Semester A 2027/2028 start of 30 August 2027. That date was not copied as the mathematics deadline.
opportunities.match_rationale: This is the university-wide monthly studentship for full-time MPhil and PhD students, including computational mathematics in the Department of Mathematics. The cited February 2026 handbook prints the basic rate as the 2025/26 figure and does not show a 2027/28 intake, so the row is possible rather than a confirmed strong match for that intake.
opportunities.intake_relevance: Ongoing award considered with research-degree admission. The handbook's printed main-round timing is the first week of December 2025. The 2027/28 steps page was not fetched.
restrictions: Full-time UGC-allocated students only
Self-financing students are not eligible for government-funded postgraduate studentships
Part-time study is outside the studentship section
Renewal requires satisfactory progress; admission notes also state a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.50 in prescribed coursework
No paid employment without prior approval of SGS
